subject: general
question: In the Unitary States, the _______ government performs all the governmental functions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__.**

__
 
• **A unitary government **is often described as **a centralized government**.
 
• **All powers **held by **the government **belong to **a single**, **central agency**.
 
• **The central (national**) government **creates local units **of **government for its convenience.**
 
• **A unitary government **is one in which all the powers of **administration **are **vested in a single centre**.
 
• **The centre **is **omnipotent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Countries **with a unitary system include the **United Kingdom, Japan, and Saudi Arabia.**
 
• **Countries **with much **larger regions**, such as the **United States**, usually have **federal systems of government.**
 
• **A unitary state **may be **divided into small units **for the **sake of administrative convenience **but the units do not have any constitutional status of their own
